title: 第3章 鬼仙第4章 楚地城隍
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
七七四十九天。
棺中漆黑如夜，陶潜睁着眼，浑浊的瞳子盯着头顶的棺板，心中一沉。
四十九天了，那鬼差还没走。
桃木拐杖化成的假尸已经开始散发腐气，这是桃木解形的前兆。最迟再有半个时辰，桃木便会现出原形，届时鬼差必然识破伪装。
一甲子苦修，毁于一旦。
魂归地府，阳寿耗尽。
“看来是逃不了。”陶潜轻叹一口气。
坟外，那猴子已经哭了四十九天。
起初几日还哭得有模有样，声泪俱下，后来嗓子哑了，只能干嚎，再往后连干嚎都嚎不出来了，蹲在坟前，有气无力地挤出几声像猫叫的呜咽。
“呜……呜呜……”
猴子抹了把脸，肚子咕噜噜响了一阵。
四十九天，他只靠山上的野果和溪水撑着，嘴皮子都干裂了，嗓子里像塞了把沙子，那鬼差就飘在坟头不远处，青幽幽的鬼火一闪一闪，跟盯梢似的。
“这老头该不会是骗我的吧？”猴子烦躁地用爪子刨了两把泥土，心里犯嘀咕，“今日已是最后期限，这老道人怕是骗不过那鬼差了。”
他回头瞟了一眼那鬼差，对方正盘腿坐在一块石头上，哭丧棒横在膝上，闭目养神。
就在这时，一道极细极弱的念头刺入猴子脑海。
“猴子，别说话，用心听。”
猴子浑身一激灵，差点跳起来，四下张望，却见那鬼差并无异动，这才按捺住。
是那老头的声音！
“你还没死啊？”猴子压低声音，嘴唇几乎没动。
“闭嘴，听老道说。”陶潜的念头微弱得像风中残烛，“桃木撑不住了，再有半个时辰就要现原形，今日你帮我一把，待我功成自当指点你去成仙之处。”

棺中，陶潜闭着眼，他不是没想过别的办法，可困在棺材夹层里，法力施展不开，唯一能做的就是传法给这猴子，让他施术迷惑鬼差。
但这个念头一冒出来，他就有些犹豫。
这猴子是谁？日后大闹天宫、搅翻地府的齐天大圣！传法于他，日后必有祸患，这猴子寻遍名山大川都没有找到愿意收徒的，就已经很能说明问题了。
可若不传……
半个时辰后他就是一缕散魂。
“罢了。”陶潜咬了咬牙，“死都要死了，还怕什么因果。”
念头刚落，脑海中忽有异动。一本古朴书卷的虚影浮现在意识深处，封面上“云笈道枢”四个篆字泛着微光。书页自行翻动，停在其中一页，一行金色小字缓缓显现：
“万般妙法，传于后人，可得一法予，初次可得两法。”
陶潜愣了一瞬。
这本云笈道枢是他在山洞中与尸解法一同得到的，这些年来翻遍了也没弄明白怎么用，只当是本废书。没想到此刻竟主动显灵了。
传法还能得法？并且第一次传还可得两门法术。
来不及细想，陶潜将最后一丝心神凝成一道游丝般的念头，顺着方才的联系，刺入猴子脑海。一篇名为《迷仙障》的术法口诀如流水般灌入其中。
猴子脑袋嗡的一声，大量的口诀、手印、运气法门如潮水般涌来。
“老……老头，这是什么？”
content_en:
Seventy-seven forty-nine days.
The coffin was as dark as night. Tao Qian opened his eyes, staring at the coffin board above his head with cloudy pupils, and his heart sank.
It's been forty-nine days and the ghost hasn't left yet.
The fake corpse transformed from Taomu's crutch has begun to emit rotten air, which is a precursor to Taomu's deformation. In half an hour at the latest, Taomu will reveal his true form, and then the ghost will definitely see through the disguise.
A decade of hard work will be ruined in one day.
The soul returns to the underworld, and the life span is exhausted.
"It seems there is no escape." Tao Qian sighed softly.
Outside the tomb, the monkey had been crying for forty-nine days.
In the first few days, I cried gracefully and burst into tears. Later, my voice became hoarse and I could only howl. After that, I couldn't even howl. I squatted in front of the grave and weakly squeezed out a few sobs like a cat's meow.
"Woo...Woo..."
The monkey wiped his face and his stomach rumbled for a while.
For forty-nine days, he only relied on wild fruits and streams on the mountain. His mouth was dry and cracked, and his throat felt like there was a handful of sand. The ghost was floating not far from the grave, and the green will-o'-the-wisp flickered like a stalker.
"Is this old man lying to me?" Monkey irritably dug two handfuls of dirt with his paws, muttering to himself, "Today is the deadline, and this old Taoist may not be able to deceive that ghost."
He turned around and glanced at the ghost chap, who was sitting cross-legged on a stone with the mourning stick across his knees, eyes closed and in meditation.
At this moment, a very thin and weak thought penetrated the monkey's mind.
"Monkey, stop talking and listen carefully."
The monkey was so excited that he almost jumped up. He looked around, but saw that the ghost didn't move, so he restrained himself.
It's the old man's voice!
"Are you not dead yet?" Monkey lowered his voice and barely moved his lips.
"Shut up and listen to the old man." Tao Qian's thoughts were as weak as a candle in the wind. "Tao Mu can't hold on anymore, and his true form will appear in another half an hour. Please help me today, and when I succeed, I will guide you to the place where you can become an immortal."
In the coffin, Tao Qian closed his eyes. It was not that he had not thought of other ways, but he was trapped in the mezzanine of the coffin and could not use his magic. The only thing he could do was to pass the magic to the monkey and let him use magic to confuse the ghost.
But as soon as the idea came up, he hesitated.
Who is this monkey? The Monkey King who will cause havoc in heaven and stir up hell in the future! If you teach him the Dharma, there will be disaster in the future. This monkey has searched all the famous mountains and rivers but can't find anyone willing to take a disciple, which is a good indication of the problem.
But if you don’t pass it on...
Half an hour later he was a ghost.
"That's all." Tao Qian gritted his teeth, "I'm going to die, so why should I be afraid of karma?"
As soon as the thought came to an end, something suddenly happened in my mind. The shadow of an ancient scroll appeared in the depths of his consciousness, and the four seal characters "Yunji Daoshu" on the cover shimmered. The pages of the book turned on their own and stopped on one page, and a line of small golden characters slowly appeared:
"All kinds of wonderful methods can be passed down to future generations, and they can get one method. For the first time, they can get two methods."
Tao Qian was stunned for a moment.
This Yunji Daoshu was obtained by him together with the Corpse Interpretation Method in the cave. After looking through it over the years, he still couldn't figure out how to use it, so he just regarded it as a useless book. Unexpectedly, he took the initiative to appear at this moment.
Can I still obtain the Fa by spreading it? And you can get two spells from the first pass.
Without time to think about it, Tao Qian condensed the last bit of his mind into a gossamer-like thought, following the connection just now, and pierced into the monkey's mind. A spellbook called "The Immortal Obstacle" poured into it like flowing water.
The monkey's head buzzed, and a large number of mantras, fingerprints, and luck techniques came flooding in.
"Old...old man, what is this?"
